errors.text_span: 在句子7附近达到最高点
errors.evidence: The peak of the curve is not near sentence 7. It is visibly later, around sentence 8 or 9.

errors.text_span: 在曲线的上升段（句子1至7附近）
errors.evidence: The rising segment of the curve does not end near sentence 7; it continues to rise until approximately sentence 9. This range is inaccurate and a consequence of misidentifying the peak.
The label "厌恶" (disgust) is not located at the end of the curve, which is at sentence 19. The label is positioned on the descending portion of the curve around sentence 14-15.

errors.text_span: 其中“感慨”位于曲线中段偏左
errors.evidence: Describing the location of the "感慨" (sigh with emotion) label as "on the middle part of the curve, to the left" is vague and unhelpful. It is more clearly located on the initial rising segment, near sentence 2.
